rationale: Measured from the 2026-07-15 Docker production client build after the discovery wall and full-screen mobile market navigation shipped, with category icon imports removed from the mobile header path. Ceilings use fixed binary review units: 64 KiB for aggregate raw JavaScript, 16 KiB for aggregate gzip and initial raw JavaScript, 4 KiB for largest/initial/async gzip JavaScript and raw CSS, 16 KiB for largest raw and async JavaScript, and 1 KiB for gzip CSS. Initial JavaScript follows the Vite entry chunk's static import graph; async limits cover route and consent-gated chunks. The development-only Mollie route remains excluded from the production build.
